mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 58 degrees. If you look toward the Northwest over Verona High School at 8:30 PM, you can catch the International Space Station crossing the sky toward Fitchburg. Overnight, we expect a low of 49 degrees with no rain predicted.

City residents can drop off e-waste for free this Saturday, October 17, at the Recycling Center on Investment Court. Additionally, the Verona Police Department is actively hiring new patrol officers for various specialized units.
There is plenty to do this week, starting with Hop Haus Trivia today and Wisconsin Brewing Company trivia. Tomorrow, check out the Farmer's Market or music at Paddy Mac's.
In police news, on September 10, officers responded to a serious incident on Hunters Cove Way where a 19-year-old was arrested following a burglary.
Culver's is open until 10:00 PM tonight, but please be aware the restaurant is currently closed for a remodeling project.
